create_CTestCaseBase_subclass: create a subclass of CTestCaseBase to define a custom test case for the component test framework
run_on_run_case: run the on_run_case method to execute a test case and return its pass/fail status
setup_on_setup_case: setup test case prerequisites by overriding on_setup_case to return True or False with a message
cleanup_on_cleanup_case: cleanup test case resources by overriding on_cleanup_case to return True or False with a message
describe_on_get_case_description: describe a test case by overriding on_get_case_description to return a custom description string
